sophia: Kicking off canary sigil-q-int8 (canary-9001). Seeing funcall parse errors ~1.4% over last 90m. Patterns: injected <<sigil>> markers inside JSON and occasional control tokens mid-string.

derek: can you paste a raw failing capture and canary id?

sophia: canary-9001. mirror replay:
```
{"op":"index","items":[{"id":1,"txt":"hello<<sigil>>","meta":{}}
```
stream cut and parser errors: "Unexpected token '<' at position ...". Also saw token tails with a control id `0` near boundaries.

parse-bot: alert: funcall_parse_error rate for sigil-q-int8 = 1.4% -> 1.9% over 30m. threshold 0.5% breached.

raj: hypothesis: quantization/decoder path injects internal sigils/comments for downstream model ops; strict JSON parsers choke when those appear or when a control token splits an escape. Short-term mitigations: transparent-sigil-strip at gateway (remove known sigil patterns), suffix-buffer for open strings, increase retry attempts on toolcall routes.

emily: quick A/B: enabled sigil-strip only for canary-tool endpoints for 30m. Result: parse errors dropped 1.4% -> 0.2%, p50 latency +18ms. Quick metrics: errors:[1.4,0.2], p50_latency_ms:[100,118]. No immediate semantic delta on a 500-sample paired check.

derek: good. we should be careful not to silently alter content for auditors. Our strip must be transparent: log original payload, stripped bytes, and token tail for every event. Add a toggle to include the stripped marker when requested.

sophia: plan: (1) keep sigil-strip scoped to funcall/tool routes in canary, (2) add audit logging for every stripped sigil and token tail, (3) run 24h paired eval (int8 vs fp16) focusing on schema compliance and semantic recall, (4) file CAN-9002 with collected examples and mirror traces.

raj: owners: @emily implement logging and toggle, @derek run token analysis and try local repro, @sophia manage rollout and metrics.

parse-bot: note: automated rollback policy will trigger if funcall_parse_error_rate > 1.0% sustained for 15m on production routes.

sophia: thanks team. I'll post the 1h snapshot in ~2h and attach the CAN-9002 ticket when created.
